items.title: Required metadata fields
items.help_text: List of required metadata fields for this MWLR Core Metadata Schema.

items.title: Title
items.help_text: A title giving an overview of the dataset.

items.title: Description
items.help_text: A descriptive abstract outlining the dataset.

items.title: Agents
items.help_text: People and organisations involved in the creation, maintenance, or management of the dataset. Each entry must specify a role.

props.title: Name
props.help_text: Full name of the person or organisation.

props.title: ORCID
props.help_text: ORCID identifier URI for the person (e.g. https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000).

props.title: Role
props.help_text: The role of this agent in relation to the dataset.

props.title: Organisation
props.help_text: The organisation the agent is affiliated with.

items.title: Date Created
items.help_text: The date the dataset was created, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.title: Resource Identifier
items.help_text: A unique identifier for the dataset, preferably a DOI or other persistent URI.

items.title: Keywords
items.help_text: Keywords or phrases describing the dataset. Controlled vocabulary to be used should be GEMET.

items.title: Resource Type
items.help_text: The nature or genre of the resource, from the DCMI Type Vocabulary. Limited subset used

items.title: Publisher
items.help_text: The entity responsible for publishing the dataset. Defaults to Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao.

items.title: Detailed metadata information
items.help_text: Additional metadata fields. These fields are not required but recommended for completeness.

items.title: Alternative Title
items.help_text: Alternative titles for the dataset. Use this field for te reo Māori titles or other variant names.

props.title: Title
props.help_text: Alternative title for the dataset.

items.title: Bibliographic Note
items.help_text: Additional comments or bibliographic notes about the dataset.

props.title: Note
props.help_text: A bibliographic note or comment about the dataset.

items.title: Date Modified
items.help_text: The date the dataset was last modified or a new version released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Repeat for each version.

props.title: Date
props.help_text: The date the dataset was modified or a new version released, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

props.title: Version
props.help_text: The version of the dataset corresponding to this modification date.

items.title: Language
items.help_text: The language(s) of the resource. Use IETF BCP 47 language tags (e.g. 'en', 'mi' for te reo Māori).

props.title: Language
props.help_text: IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g. 'en', 'mi').

items.title: Temporal Coverage
items.help_text: The time span the dataset covers.

items.title: Start Date
items.help_text: Start of the temporal coverage period, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.title: End Date
items.help_text: End of the temporal coverage period, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit if ongoing.

items.title: Temporal Description
items.help_text: Free-text description of the temporal coverage where precise dates are not available.

items.title: Geographic element

props.title: Geographic Bounding Box
West bound longitude
props.help_text: Western-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in longitude in decimal degrees.

props.title: East bound longitude
props.help_text: Eastern-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in longitude in decimal degrees.

props.title: South bound latitude
props.help_text: Southern-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in latitude in decimal degrees.

props.title: North bound latitude
props.help_text: Northern-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in latitude in decimal degrees.

This is the extent of the resource in the geographic space, given as a bounding box. Defining the coordinates of a rectangle representing the resource area on a map allows the discovery by geographical area. Click to draw a bounding box on the map or enter coordinates manually.

Provide the coordinates bounding the limits of the dataset, by means of four properties:
- West bound longitude: Western-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in longitude in decimal degrees.
- East bound longitude: Eastern-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in longitude in decimal degrees.
- South bound latitude: Southern-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in latitude in decimal degrees.
- North bound latitude: Northern-most coordinate of the limit of the dataset extent, expressed in latitude in decimal degrees.

The bounding box shall be as small as possible.
The bounding box shall be expressed in decimal degree with a precision of at least 2 decimals.

props.title: Geohash
Geohash
props.help_text: The geohash is not explicitly defined in ISO 19139, but often used in profiles, extensions, or auxiliary metadata to support spatial search, indexing, or approximate location. For example, "u4pruydqqvj" represents a specific area near New York City. Geohashes can vary in length; more characters mean higher precision.

props.title: Note
props.help_text: A descriptive or explanatory note about the Geohash value — e.g., resolution, use, limitations. For example, "Geohash at 8-character precision (~19 meters accuracy)."

A short alphanumeric string representing a spatial location or bounding box using the Geohash encoding. The purpose is to provide a compact, human-readable, and indexable way to encode geographic areas.

props.title: Geographic description
props.help_text: A textual or coded description of the geographic area covered by the dataset or service. The purpose is to provide a named place or coded region (e.g., country, administrative unit) as a way to describe geographic extent, especially when precise coordinates or geometry are not available. This useful for indexing metadata by regions or matching data to known administrative areas.

props.title: Bounding polygon
Polygon identifier (ID)
props.help_text: A unique identifier assigned to the polygon for referencing or validation. The purpose is to allow referencing this specific geometry within the metadata or from external systems.

props.title: Polygon
Interior or exterior ring
props.help_text:
Rings that define the boundary of the polygon. Each ring is defined with a list of coordinates.
       - Exterior ring: The outer boundary of the polygon.
       - Interior ring: One or more holes within the polygon (optional).

props.title: Type
props.help_text: The type of geometry used to represent the area. Common types are Polygon (a single closed area), MultiPolygon (a set of multiple polygons), and Envelope (a bounding rectangle).

props.title: Coordinates
props.help_text: Coordinates of the polygon. These are the longitude-latitude pairs that define the polygon boundary. Each pair is ordered as <longitude> <latitude>, separated by spaces. The first and last coordinates must be the same to close the polygon.
A geometric object that defines the shape and extent of the area covered. This is defined in GML (Geography Markup Language), typically using EPSG:4326 (WGS 84) as the coordinate system.

A polygonal shape describing the precise spatial coverage of the dataset or service. The purpose is to provide more accurate spatial boundaries than a bounding box, especially for irregular or non-rectangular areas.

items.help_text:
Spatial (horizontal) extent element. This can be defined either with a Bounding Box (recommended); or using Geographic Description - free text that defines the area covered. When the dataset covers one or more countries, it is recommended to enter the country names in this element, as it can then be used in data catalogs for filtering by geography.

The bounding box shall be as small as possible.
The bounding box shall be expressed in decimal degree with a precision of at least 2 decimals.

items.title: Temporal element

props.title: beginPosition
props.help_text: Begin time position. Requires an extended ISO 8601 formatted combined UTC date and time string (2009-11-17T10:00:00)

props.title: endPosition
props.help_text: End time position. Requires an extended ISO 8601 formatted combined UTC date and time string (2009-11-17T10:00:00)

items.help_text:
The temporal extent defines the time period covered by the content of the resource. Depending on the temporal characteristics of the dataset, this will consist in a Time period (made of a begin position and end position) or a time instant (made of a single time position) referencing date/time information according to ISO 8601.

This time period may be expressed as:
- an individual date
- an interval of dates (starting date and ending date)
- a mix of individual dates and intervals of dates

items.title: Vertical element
items.help_text: Spatial (vertical) extent element, providing two properties: minimum value, maximum value and vertical CRS (reference to the vertical coordinate reference system)

items.title: Provenance / Project Description
items.help_text: Information about the history or project context of the dataset, including project codes.

props.title: Description
props.help_text: A description of the provenance or project context. Can include project codes or other relevant details.

items.title: Rights Holder
items.help_text: The entity that holds rights over the dataset. Specify if not Bioeconomy Science Institute Maiangi Taiao.

items.title: License
items.help_text: The license under which the dataset is made available. Include any data sharing agreements.

items.title: Access Rights
items.help_text: Information about who can access the dataset, or its embargo status.

items.title: Format
items.help_text: The file format(s) of the dataset. If files use different file types use dominant type

props.title: Format
props.help_text: The file format of the dataset (e.g. 'CSV', 'GeoTIFF').

items.title: Related Resources
items.help_text: Resources related to this dataset, such as journal papers, methodology descriptions. Prefer URIs (e.g. DOIs).

props.title: Description of Relation
props.help_text: A description of the relationship to the related resource.

props.title: URI
props.help_text: A URI identifying the related resource (e.g. DOI, URL).

items.title: Is Part Of
items.help_text: The collection or larger dataset this dataset belongs to (e.g. NZLRI).

props.title: Collection Name
props.help_text: The name of the collection or larger dataset this dataset is part of.

props.title: Collection URI
props.help_text: A URI identifying the collection or larger dataset (e.g. DOI, URL).

items.title: Derived From / Source
items.help_text: A description of the resource or datasets from which this dataset was derived.

props.title: Source Description
props.help_text: A description of the source resource or dataset.

props.title: Source URI
props.help_text: A URI identifying the source resource or dataset (e.g. DOI, URL).

items.title: Location of Data
items.help_text: Where the data is stored. Should be updated when storage location changes.

props.title: Data Location
props.help_text: A description of the location where the data is stored.

props.title: Location URI
props.help_text: A URI identifying the location where the data is stored (e.g. DOI, URL).

items.title: Audience
items.help_text: The intended audience or expected users of the dataset.

props.title: Audience Description
props.help_text: A description of the intended audience or expected users of the dataset.

items.title: Version
items.help_text: The version of the dataset.
